name: reactivate_privileges
description: reactivate_privileges: Reactivate one or more suspended clinical privileges for a provider. Returns a case_id on success. Only privileges that are currently suspended can be reactivated.

privilege_codes.description: The privilege codes to reactivate. Format per code: PRV-CATEGORY-3digits. Only include codes the caller explicitly confirmed. Example: [PRV-CARD-001, PRV-ICU-003]

clearance_code.description: The occupational health clearance code. Format: CLR-LETTERS-6digits. Example: CLR-OCC-048271

leave_type_on_record.description: The type of leave the provider was on (mutually exclusive): medical_leave (employer-approved medical, not FMLA), personal_leave (approved personal/unpaid, not medical or FMLA), or fmla_leave (FMLA-protected leave)
